entry.title: New: dsh-auto-reviewer
entry.summary: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations. Exact install spec: github:antarescorn/dsh-auto-reviewer. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
